'''Ruusanians''' were approximately 20,000 preindustrial [[Near-Human]]s<ref name="Power of the Jedi Sourcebook">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref> from [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]]. They developed due to inbreeding amongst the small [[Human/Legends|Human]] population of Ruusan; they were hardy and well-adapted to a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] environment.

Surface artifacts suggest that other species lived on Ruusan as well, making it possible that Ruusanians originated from somewhere else.
